aiExplanation.summary: This file defines the owner-aware contracts for inspecting, confirming, and applying Agent Note updates.
aiExplanation.detail:
- CurrentAgentNotesResult: Returns the active Store identity and validated responseLanguage.
- InspectAgentNotesInput and InspectAgentNotesResult: Describe safe read-only source and Note inspection.
- AgentNoteUpdatePlan and ApplyAgentNoteUpdatesInput: Describe hash-guarded AI Note changes and confirmation.
- AgentNoteUpdateReport: Reports per-file outcomes and totals.
